prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: square white-tile logo variant for a dark UI or README
Edit target: the provided Codex Mem logo image
Primary request: Preserve the original near-black outer mark and dark-gray inner retained tab exactly: same C-like archive/open-page geometry, same proportions, same edge contours, same placement, same negative space, same square framing. Place the mark on a flat, uniform, opaque white square background.
Background: solid pure white across the entire square canvas; no transparency and no checkerboard.
Style/medium: flat restrained monochrome brand mark; one clean logo tile.
Composition/framing: identical square canvas and centered mark with the same margins as the source.
Color palette: near-black outer mark, dark-gray inner layer, pure white background.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: preserve the existing logo geometry and colors; change only the background to solid opaque white; no redesign; no new elements; exactly one logo tile.
Avoid: checkerboard, transparency, gradients, shadows, glow, bevel, 3D, texture, colored background, border, text, watermark, mockup, presentation board, screenshot, multiple variants.

validation.notes: Rendered as a clean opaque near-white tile with no checkerboard, text, shadow, or gradient visible.
